title: WR-90 filled with a lossy dielectric (εr = 2.2, tan δ = 0.02), 30 mm, ports in it: the noise figure of the matched lossy line
source: A matched passive line of loss L at physical temperature T has noise temperature Te = (L − 1)T and noise figure F = 1 + (L − 1)T/T₀, T₀ = 290 K (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §10.1), with L = |S21|⁻² of the line's closed form, S21 = e^{−γL}, γ = √((π/a)² − k0² εr(1 − j tan δ)) (lossy-line's reference), evaluated separately from EMCraft's code
